full_prompt_en: A detailed Venetian Renaissance-style city painting looks across a green harbor toward a fortified waterfront filled with people. In the foreground, several small wooden boats drift on dark teal water, their hulls and awnings rendered with crisp miniature detail. Behind them, a dense crowd gathers along the embankment and before a monumental central gateway. The gateway is flanked by two tall round towers and broad sandy walls, all warmed by late afternoon sunlight. Above it, a large golden dome rises between smaller cupolas and slender spires. Beyond the main complex, an immense city fills the upper field with overlapping rooftops, towers, arches, and distant domes that grow finer and paler toward the horizon. The composition is strongly layered: reflective water at the bottom, a busy horizontal strip of people, a solid middle band of masonry, and a finely patterned skyline beneath a pale cream sky. The many figures are very small but individually varied enough to form a living texture rather than a single dark line. Straight vertical edges and round domes create a measured rhythm against the irregular crowd and boat shapes. The painting uses a warm limited palette of ocher, sand, terracotta, olive brown, cream, and deep green water, with subtle blue-gray atmospheric softness in the far distance. Light catches the left sides of towers and domes, while narrow shadow seams emphasize depth between structures. Fine controlled brushwork records windows, battlements, vessels, and tiny garments; broader smooth fields keep the architecture legible. The overall image feels ceremonial and panoramic, turning a crowded civic moment into an ordered, richly observed view.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅细密威尼斯文艺复兴风格城市绘画越过绿色港水，望向挤满人群的设防水岸。前景几只小木船漂在深青绿水上，船体和篷以清楚微型细节描出。其后，密集人群聚在堤岸和中央纪念性城门前。城门两侧是两座高圆塔及宽阔沙色城墙，均被晚间日光温暖。其上，一座大金穹顶升在较小穹顶和细高尖塔之间。主体建筑之后，巨大城市以上下叠合的屋顶、塔、拱及远穹填满上方视域，越近地平线越细越浅。构图层次强：底部反光水、繁忙水平人带、中部坚实砖石带，以及浅奶油天空下细纹天际线。众多人物极小，却各有变化，形成活的纹理，而非一条暗线。直竖边与圆穹在不规则人群和船形之间建立有分寸节奏。画面用暖而有限的赭、沙、赤陶、橄榄褐、奶油及深绿水，远处带微妙蓝灰空气柔度。光抓住塔与穹的左侧，狭窄阴影接缝强调构造间的深度。精细受控笔触记下窗、垛口、船和微小衣装；更宽平滑色域使建筑可读。整体庄严全景化，把拥挤公共时刻转成有秩序且观察丰厚的视域。
style_prompt_en: Renaissance-style panoramic painting layers a view into a dark reflective lower band, a densely stippled middle strip, broad warm solid planes, and finely diminishing background detail. Ocher, sand, terracotta, olive brown, cream, and deep teal remain closely related, with distant marks softening toward blue-gray. Crisp vertical edges and rounded upper forms alternate in a measured repeated rhythm. Fine controlled brushwork describes many tiny irregular marks at the lower center, while larger smooth color areas preserve the central structure and spatial hierarchy. Warm directional light catches selected left-facing planes and leaves narrow dark seams between overlapping masses. Perspective is orderly but softened by atmospheric distance; the focal region stays solid, and remote layers become pale and intricate. The composition feels ceremonial and expansive, balancing geometric repetition with the restless life of small textured marks.
style_prompt_zh: 文艺复兴风格全景绘画把视域叠成下方深反光带、中段密点条、宽阔暖色坚实平面和逐渐缩小的背景细节。赭、沙、赤陶、橄榄褐、奶油与深青密切相关，远处笔点向蓝灰柔化。清晰竖边与圆浑上方形体以有分寸的重复节奏交替。精细受控笔触在下方中央描绘大量细小不规则痕迹，更宽平滑色域维持中央构造和空间层级。暖定向光抓住精选朝左平面，交叠体量间留下狭窄暗缝。透视有秩序，却由空气距离柔化；焦点区域结实，远层浅且细密。构图庄严宽广，以几何重复平衡小纹理笔点的躁动生命。
theme_en: A crowded waterfront gathers before a domed fortified city in golden light
theme_zh: 拥挤水岸人群聚集在金光中的穹顶城池前
name: Gentile Bellini
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
